about_the_game:
Davis Haunted House is a 2D Top-Down Survival Horror game based on the story of a haunted house that was built during the 1970s, haunted by demons and other evil spirits.

Davis House was first built during the 1970s by a rich entrepreneur, Davis, who lived in the house with his family. A tragic incident occurred during the 1980s, which was actually the beginning of the paranormal activities in the house. It was said that Davis's sons actually carried out a Satanic ritual in the basement area, which brought in evil forces inside the house. One of his sons went crazy after the ritual and was admitted to a mental hospital in the city. After he returned home from the hospital, his mother actually noticed that there was something wrong with his behavior even though the doctor said that he was perfectly healthy. During the midnight hours, he took an axe and charged towards his mother, who was on the staircase, but he slipped and fell down the stairs and died.

His spirit is often seen holding an axe in the attic and basement even today. During the 1990s, Davis sold the house to a family. Soon after the family moved in, they started experiencing paranormal activities. The activity increased to the point that it compelled the family to ask Mia, a local paranormal investigator, to check out the house and to help out the family.

You play as Mia, the paranormal investigator, and your mission is to investigate the whole house for paranormal evidence. Will you be able to help out the family?

Key Features:

  • Explore the entire Davis Haunted House!
  • Come face to face with the Evil spirits!
  • Use ghost hunting equipment like cameras, emf meter, etc.
  • Avoid traps like spikes, demon arms etc.
  • Explore the spirit world!
  • Around half an hour of paranormal investigation!

Warning:

This game contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.
